title: eng-releases
text:
eng-releases

maria: quick heads-up — prepping a soft-toggle for feature `quiet-mode` in the 22:00 UTC change window. plan below, looking for ops ack.

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout queued for 2024-11-08 22:00 UTC. canary target: service-llm-route, commit abc1234. dry-run passes.

kevin: ack. what's the ramp plan and the abort criteria? also confirm pinning behavior if we need to rollback.

maria: ramp -> 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100%, 10m between steps. holdpoints at 5m/15m/30m after each shift. abort if token latency P95 > 600ms or error rate delta > 0.8% relative to baseline.

carla: we'll pin traffic to model v2.1 on canary nodes only. if rollback, deploy-bot will repoint cohort -> v2.0 pinned and drain new v2.1 sessions. @deploy-bot confirm sticky session behavior.

deploy-bot: confirm: canary cohort pinned to model:v2.1; sticky sessions preserved for 30s after switch; rollback workflow: set flag -> re-pin -> drain. Will emit events to #eng-oncall. :robot_face:

dave: small nit — let's start with a 2m pre-check after canary enable to validate KV cache warmup. if cold-cache tokens spike, we should pause and run a targeted retry test.

maria: good call. updated plan: pre-check 2m, then 1% for 5m (quick telemetry), then as above. failing pre-check pauses rollout.

kevin: what are the rollback runbook steps? add them to the release notes before toggle.

maria: runbook short list: 1) disable ff (quiet-mode=false) via deploy-bot, 2) set routing pin to model:v2.0, 3) evict v2.1 workers from pool, 4) monitor SLOs for 20m, 5) open incident channel if persistent. I'll paste full notes in the release doc.

maria: release notes link: https://docs.internal/redwood/releases/2024-11-08-quiet-mode — includes traffic slices, test prompts, and rollback checklists.

carla: can we add a guard to stop at 20% if cost per token jumps > 30%? want auto-safety for cost regressions.

deploy-bot: added numeric guard: cost_delta_threshold=0.30, telemetry watch target=transactions.tokens_per_sec, alert_channel=#eng-releases

kevin: ops ack from me. @maria schedule the actual toggle and ping eng-oncall 15m before.

maria: scheduled 22:00 UTC. pinging eng-oncall 21:45 UTC. thanks team. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: canary enable executed at 2024-11-08T22:00:00Z for cohort=canary-1. event id db7a9.

maria: monitoring dashboards now — watching latency, error rate, cost, and quality evals. will post updates in-thread.

maria: 22:02 — pre-check good, KV warmup stable.

carla: 22:08 — 1% steady, no error spikes. go to 5%.

deploy-bot: ramped to 5% at 2024-11-08T22:10:00Z.

kevin: watching. looks clean so far.

maria: 22:22 — 20% holdpoint: slight cost uptick (+12%) but within guard. continuing to 50% after hold.

dave: rolling health looks green. monitoring will continue for 30m after 100%.

maria: final 100% at 22:55 UTC. closing thread with postmortem stub — will capture metrics and any anomalies.

kevin: thanks all. great coordination. :pray:
